claim_boundary: The official broad-dollar series and prior Agora decision support a distinct external-FX-stress question, not alpha. This prior authorizes one exact 13-week annualized RMS weekly-log-change volatility state with 8-week and 26-week rejection-only neighbors, a lagged 52-observation median, and a 100/50-percent BTC passive-core policy.
causal_hypothesis: Unusually high broad-dollar volatility can mark unstable global funding and cross-currency risk transmission that raises BTC path risk even when the direction of the dollar is not predictive.
economic_hypothesis: Reducing BTC exposure from 100 to 50 percent only during high lagged broad-dollar volatility may preserve at least 70 percent of buy-and-hold upside while reducing drawdown enough to improve after-cost Calmar with annual and neighbor breadth.

primary_prior_matrix.identity: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System Nominal Broad U.S. Dollar Index via FRED
primary_prior_matrix.finding: DTWEXBGS is the official daily nominal broad U.S. dollar index from the Federal Reserve H.10 release.
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The present-vintage index is not DXY, does not identify an exogenous shock and does not prove that its volatility forecasts BTC risk.

primary_prior_matrix.identity: Karau, Monetary policy and Bitcoin, Journal of International Money and Finance 137 (2023)
primary_prior_matrix.finding: Bitcoin transmission from U.S. monetary conditions is time-varying and became more risk-asset-like in the later sample.
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: A monetary-policy shock is not broad-dollar realized volatility, and the paper does not validate this exposure rule.

primary_prior_matrix.identity: Agora sealed broad-dollar direction family decision
primary_prior_matrix.finding: The exact negative four-week dollar-direction DRA admission rule failed economics and predictive gates, while its sealed uncertainty explicitly left independently preregistered dollar-volatility mechanisms unevaluated.
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: This family may not reuse the closed sign, horizon, admission action or inverse rule; it must test volatility as a separate external path-risk state once.

independence_assessment.distinct_from_closed_dollar_direction: The feature discards sign and measures the RMS magnitude of weekly dollar changes. The previous decision explicitly states that dollar-volatility mechanisms were not evaluated.
independence_assessment.distinct_from_closed_btc_volatility: The state is computed only from an external Federal Reserve currency index, not BTC returns, range, drawdown or volatility.
independence_assessment.distinct_from_closed_daily_technical_fam: No BTC outcome input enters the decision feature; BTC is used only for matched-capital strategy economics after the specification is frozen.

stop_conditions: Freeze hypothesis, manifest, runner, source hashes, costs, windows and all-pass gates before opening this family outcome.
Use only the exact sealed weekly DTWEXBGS source and Friday-plus-five-day availability; no new network request, repair or revision substitution is permitted.
Primary is 13 weeks; 8 and 26 weeks are rejection-only and cannot replace it after outcome access.
Any primary or neighbor gate failure permanently closes the exact family without lookback, reference, threshold, weight, direction, timing, cost or parent tuning.
A positive historical result remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and requires one independent sealed OOS.
missing_proof: Present-vintage DTWEXBGS does not prove original real-time H.10 vintages.
No matched-capital PnL, drawdown, Calmar, upside, holding, annual breadth, candidate or OOS outcome for this volatility family has been observed.
